name: Markdown Vault
description: Lists markdown notes with frontmatter from a folder of one of your Orca projects on the Tasks page, and starts a workspace for a note. The folder's markdown-vault.md note configures it for everyone.

settings.title: Vault project
settings.description: The Orca project the notes live in: a local folder, a Git or a Perforce project, on this computer or over SSH.

settings.title: Notes folder
settings.description: Folder inside the project, with forward slashes. Empty lists the whole project. Its markdown-vault.md note, if any, configures how the notes read.

settings.title: Read notes from
settings.description: Latest reads the newest version on the project's server (Git: the fetched upstream branch; Perforce: the depot head), so nothing needs syncing. Disk reads the files in the project folder.

settings.title: You
settings.description: How notes name you as owner (an email or a name), for the Mine filter.
